Help

Discovers every .hang broadcast announced on the relay and lists it in the People panel. Opens as a collage that resizes to the room; click a tile to spotlight it (big stage, everyone else on the right-hand ladder, the current speaker enlarged), click the big tile to return. Sharing a screen, RTSP feed or file takes the spotlight automatically; a green ring means audio is arriving. Streams this machine is publishing appear under My streams, never in the grid. Share opens the publishing controls without leaving this page; Stats below has codec, resolution, throughput and the raw catalog.

← →select the previous / next watched stream
1–9select by row number (watched rows only)
Ffull-screen the selected stream
Gcollage / spotlight (same as clicking a tile)
Mmute everything
Ddeafen: hear nothing and mute your mic (again to undo)
Escclose panels; leave full screen

Rows: click to select; ●/○ watches or parks a stream (parked = nothing downloads); the speaker plays several streams at once; the slider sets that stream's own level. Tiles: drag anywhere to reorder (collage); click a ladder tile to swap it into the big stage.
